killedBy: moment recipes naming developer arms (issue #775) carries a recipe's shell-trail arm into the fire moment's page request, and nothing without it
why: The forwarding #775 adds. Without it a recipe that names `shellTrail: segments` still validates, still records the arm it asked for, and captures the shipped render -- the silent no-op the gallery's own refusals exist to prevent. The provenance check in the same adapter would also catch it on a real run; this entry pins the argv half, which no real run is needed to see.
